title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
布鲁克林高地。作为布鲁克林区为数不多的富人区之一。这里不仅临近布鲁克林公园和伊斯特河，风光优美，而且还有巡警二十四小时巡逻，保障住户的人身安全。卢克家之所以能住在这里，还是他父母去世时留给他的一大笔保险赔偿金帮的忙。不过现在，这一切都跟他没关系了。偷偷摸到自家的窗户下，听到卧室里那些令人血脉贲张的声音，卢克有些痛苦地闭上了眼睛，回忆起自己曾经跟妻子的那些甜蜜画面。曾几何时他们也是邻居口中的模范夫妻，为什么会走到现在这种地步？难道仅仅是因为这个黑鬼可以满足她吗？！曾经的美好回忆就像是一条无法挣脱的绳索，死死缠住他的脖颈，回忆越多，绳索越紧。直到听到房间里那个黑鬼德隆特.威斯汀的声音：“小婊砸，韦斯特爸爸要出去干活儿了，明天再来法克你的爱思！”卢克脑海中那根名为理智的弦彻底崩断了。失去理智的他轻易将卧室墙壁撞出一个人形大窟窿，在妻子惊恐的目光下，一拳将德隆特这个黑鬼的脑袋打爆。就像是一个西瓜碎了一地，红的、白的顿时溅得到处都是。躺在床上光着身子的女人突然被溅了一身，半边脸，身下湿漉漉的床单都染上了色彩，直接吓得高声尖叫。“啊啊啊——”这尖利的女高音瞬间吸引了卢克家周围邻居，以及巡警的注意。两名胸前挂着银色警徽的警员快步赶来，在看清楚房间里的惨剧之后，迅速拔出枪指着卢克，厉声道：“先生，立即双手抱头蹲下，请不要做任何多余的动作。”“......”正在享受复仇快感余韵的卢克回过神来，一点不在意地瞥了两名警察一眼，低头看着自己染血的手。原来，复仇是这么舒服的。比干什么事都要愉悦，多巴胺就像水闸泄洪一样涌出，舒服得全身都在颤抖。“先生，再次警告一遍，立即双手抱头蹲下，请不要做任何多余的动作！！”两名警员的声音再次提高了一个档次。房间里的女人仿佛看到了救星一样，抱着被子向他们跑来，并且一边跑，一边尖叫道：“警官，快开枪打死他，他是个怪物，一拳就杀死了我男朋友！！”“呵。”听到这句话的卢克笑了。他一把抓起床头边还没来得及清理的结婚相片，将其用力甩了出去。嗖嗖！！木头打造的相框此时在卢克怪力的加持下，远比一般的武器还要可怕。女人向前跑的动作瞬间僵住。她的胸口被木头相框洞穿出一个大洞，低头望去，正好能看到露出的那一截照片上，年轻的她挽着丈夫的手笑颜如花。“开火！

！”两名警察吓得立即扣动了扳机。硝烟弥漫间，卢克被数十颗金属子弹击中。他人没事，身上的衣服却更加破烂了。这让他原本已经平静下来的内心再次升起一团怒火。“这是你们自找的！！”房间里的地板瞬间被踏碎，卢克整个人如同炮弹般激射而出。砰砰！！在激烈的枪声中，左边那边大腹便便的中年警察被迅速近身。卢克在他绝望的眼神中，直接朝他脖子劈下，一颗头颅就这么飞速离开了躯体。而眼看右边那位年轻警察马上也要步入后尘。这位年轻警察终于认出了浑身是血，很久没刮胡子的卢克。他颤声道：“卢克叔叔，我是小约翰，老约翰的儿子。”“老约翰？！”卢克停了下来，沉默地望了一眼面前这个可能才二十出头的年轻人之后，收起拳头转身离开。“呜哇呜哇！！”而就在卢克离开的十分钟后，一辆辆警车停在了布鲁克林高地小区门口。全副武装的布鲁克林辖区警员，还有法医们从车上下来，井然有序地开始了工作，拉开警戒线，勘察现场。而其中一辆黑色雪佛兰SUV车上走下来四人，赫然是以乔治.詹特利为首的特别调查司警探。他们一般只负责纽约市范围内性质恶劣的重大犯罪，比如说前不久发生在爱尔兰帮地盘上的黑帮火拼案。可以说得上是见多识广。但。。。。。。卢克家这么诡异的现场还是让几名经验丰富的警探惊住了。他们几人每个人都穿上了鞋套、手套、帽子，小心地走进案发现场。当看到卧室墙壁上那个卢克撞出的人形大窟窿时，其中一名棕色头发的警探回过头看向乔治.詹特利，咂舌道：“头儿，你说这世界上不会真有什么改造人，变异人之类的吧？”乔治.詹特利仔细地扫视房间里所有角落，不放过任何一点细节。直到确定自己没有遗漏后，他才吐出一口气，看着地上呈不规则状溅射的血液摇头道：“以前可能没有，我们现在遇上了。”
content_en:
Brooklyn Heights.As one of the few wealthy areas in Brooklyn.Not only is it close to Brooklyn Park and the East River, with beautiful scenery, but there are also patrols patrolling the area 24 hours a day to ensure the personal safety of residents.The reason why Luke's family can live here is because of the large amount of insurance compensation left to him when his parents died.But now, all this has nothing to do with him.Sneaking under the window of his home and hearing the blood-curdling sounds in the bedroom, Luke closed his eyes in pain, recalling the sweet scenes he had with his wife.Once upon a time, they were also considered a model couple by their neighbors. Why did they end up like this?Is it just because this nigger can satisfy her?!The good memories of the past were like an inescapable rope, tightly wrapped around his neck. The more memories he had, the tighter the rope became.Until he heard the voice of Delonte Westin, the nigger in the room: "Little bitch, West's father is going out to work, come back tomorrow to facquer your love!" The string called reason in Luke's mind completely broke.Losing his mind, he easily knocked out a large human-shaped hole in the bedroom wall, and under the horrified eyes of his wife, he punched Delonte, a nigger, in the head.It was like a watermelon shattered on the ground, red and white splashing everywhere.The naked woman lying on the bed was suddenly splashed all over her body. Half of her face and the wet sheets beneath her were stained with color, and she screamed loudly in fright."Ah ah ah -" This sharp soprano instantly attracted the attention of the neighbors around Luke's house and the patrol police.Two police officers with silver police badges on their chests rushed over. After seeing clearly the tragedy in the room, they quickly pulled out their guns and pointed them at Luke. They said sternly: "Sir, immediately squat down with your hands on your head. Please don't make any unnecessary movements." "..." Luke, who was enjoying the aftertaste of revenge, came back to his senses. He glanced at the two police officers indifferently and looked down at his bloody hands.It turns out that revenge is so comfortable.It was more pleasurable than anything else. Dopamine surged out like a flood, making my whole body tremble with comfort."Sir, I'm warning you again. Immediately squat down with your hands on your head. Please don't make any unnecessary movements!!" The voices of the two police officers raised a level again.The woman in the room seemed to have seen a savior, running towards them with the quilt in her arms, and screaming as she ran: "Officer, shoot him quickly, he is a monster, he killed my boyfriend with one punch!!" "Ha." Luke laughed after hearing this.He grabbed the wedding photo beside the bed that he hadn't even had time to clean up, and threw it out hard.Whoosh!!At this time, the photo frame made of wood, blessed by Luke's strange power, was far more terrifying than ordinary weapons.The woman's movement to run forward froze instantly.A big hole was punched out of her chest by the wooden photo frame. Looking down, she could just see the exposed part of the photo, where she was holding her husband's hand and smiling like a flower."Fire!

!"The two policemen were so frightened that they immediately pulled the trigger.As the smoke filled the air, Luke was hit by dozens of metal bullets.The others were fine, but their clothes were even more tattered.This caused a ball of anger to rise up again in his already calm heart."You asked for this!!" The floor in the room was instantly trampled to pieces, and Luke's whole body shot out like a cannonball.Bang bang!!Amidst the fierce gunfire, the middle-aged policeman with a big belly on the left was quickly approached.With his desperate look in his eyes, Luke slashed directly at his neck, and his head quickly left his body.And it seems that the young policeman on the right is about to follow suit.The young policeman finally recognized Luke, who was covered in blood and had not shaved for a long time.He trembled: "Uncle Luke, I am Little John, the son of Old John." "Old John?!" Luke stopped, looked at the young man in front of him in silence, who was probably in his early twenties, put away his fists and turned around to leave."Whoa whoa whoa!!" And just ten minutes after Luke left, police cars parked at the entrance of the Brooklyn Heights community.The heavily armed Brooklyn police officers and forensic scientists got out of the car and started working in an orderly manner, setting up a cordon and surveying the scene.Four people got out of one of the black Chevrolet SUVs, and they turned out to be detectives from the Special Investigation Division headed by George Gentry.They are generally only responsible for major crimes of egregious nature within New York City, such as the recent gang fight that occurred on the territory of the Irish Gang.It can be said that he is well-informed.but......Such a strange scene at Luke's house still shocked several experienced police detectives.Each of them put on shoe covers, gloves, and hats, and carefully walked into the crime scene.When he saw the large human-shaped hole made by Luke on the bedroom wall, one of the brown-haired police detectives turned back to look at George Gentry and smacked his lips: "Boss, you said there are no real modified people, mutants or the like in this world, right?" George Gentry carefully scanned all the corners of the room, not missing any detail.It wasn't until he was sure that he hadn't missed anything that he let out a breath, looked at the blood splattering irregularly on the ground, shook his head, and said, "It may not have happened before, but we have encountered it now."
